business_summary: CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of health foods. It provides Chinese medicine-based health supplements in capsule, tablet, drink, and tea forms. The company was formerly known as CKH Food & Health Limited and changed its name to CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited in October 2023. CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited was founded in 2009 and is based in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.
business_summary_ko: CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited는 건강식품의 제조 및 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 캡슐, 정제, 음료, 차 형태의 한방 기반 건강 보조제를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 CKH Food & Health Limited로 알려졌으며 2023년 10월에 CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. CXI Healthcare Technology Group Limited는 2009년에 설립되었으며 케이맨 제도의 그랜드 케이먼에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
